beats: The relief boat leaves you on a timber jetty at the mouth of the estuary. The lamp on the tower above has been dark for three nights.
Gulls complain overhead. A boatman coils rope and does not look up.

endings.name: The Lamp Relit
beats: You lay out the facts, and the lamp room goes very quiet. By nightfall the beam is sweeping the water again.

endings.name: A Cook Wrongly Named
beats: You name the cook. She stares at you, then at the floor, and the cottage never speaks to you again.

endings.name: The Dark Water
beats: Ten o'clock strikes below. Somewhere out in the murk a hull finds the sandbar, and no light warns it.
